faq.whatIsSanaaA: SANAA is your AI receptionist inside Book With AI -- she answers your salon's calls so you never have to leave a client to pick up the phone.
faq.whatCanSanaaDoA: She answers calls, books, reschedules and cancels appointments, answers common questions, transfers to a real person when needed, and can work after hours.
faq.isSanaaRealPersonA: No -- SANAA is an AI receptionist. She never pretends to be a human employee.
faq.canBookWithAiSetUpQ: Can Book With AI set SANAA up for me?
faq.canBookWithAiSetUpA: Yes -- alongside self setup, a concierge option exists for salons who'd rather have it done for them. Details on that option are coming soon.
faq.currentNumberQ: What happens to my current salon number?
faq.transferCallsQ: Can SANAA transfer calls to me?
faq.transferCallsA: Yes -- SANAA can hand a call to a real person when needed.
faq.canPauseA: Yes -- you can pause SANAA at any time from her Operations screen.
faq.afterHoursA: Yes -- after-hours coverage is one of her core capabilities.
faq.bookAppointmentsA: Yes -- booking is her hero capability.
faq.knowAvailabilityQ: How does SANAA know my availability?
faq.knowAvailabilityA: She reads your salon's real schedule in Book With AI.
faq.knowIsAiQ: Will customers know SANAA is AI?
faq.knowIsAiA: Yes -- SANAA never intentionally impersonates a human employee.
faq.dontKnowAnswerQ: What happens if SANAA doesn't know an answer?
faq.controlWhatSaysQ: Can I control what SANAA says?
faq.paymentFailsQ: What happens if my payment fails?
faq.reviewActivityA: Yes -- every call is visible in her Calls & Activity screen.
faq.turnOffA: Yes, any time -- pausing SANAA stops her from answering calls immediately.

controlSection.point1: SANAA works within the rules you configure for your salon.
controlSection.point2: You can review everything SANAA has done.
controlSection.point4: You can pause SANAA at any time.
controlSection.point5: SANAA only takes actions you've permitted.
